t-proposed.text: Proposed: your access level picks your screen

n-today.text:
MEASURED NOV 9
All 7 active people get this same screen: Dr. Q (owner), Aj and Alli (producers), Sophie, Tyler, Whitney and Zach (team members).

Sidebar: Create plus 16 places. Home, Overview, Insights, SEO, Your week, Bernard, Stories, Moments, Ads, Library, Book, Pre-Visit, Usage, Knowledge synthesis, Settings, My profile.

Home: the producer's queue stacked on top of the clinician's home.

Why: Bernard's lookup of each person's access level has been failing silently since late May, so everyone reads as "no level set". At Move Better that means owner.

The picture is the test login, whose level is Team member. Dr. Q's own login showed the same queue and the same numbers.

n-clinician.text:
TEAM MEMBER SCREEN
Rule: your Access level picks your screen. Team member gets this one.

Sidebar goes from 16 places to 4: Home, My stories (the Stories list, filtered to yours), Library, My profile. The other 12 leave the sidebar but still open by link for anyone the server allows.

Home is two jobs. 1) Start your call. 2) Waiting on your OK: only things from your own interviews that only you can approve. Other people's posts and the "who is overdue" list are gone from this screen. Make a point moves below the two jobs.

The rule applied to today's real rows:
Tyler: 1 blog, 1 answer (drawn)
Sophie: 2 blogs
Zach: 0 blogs, 4 answers
Whitney: nothing waiting

Open question: answers and word sign-offs on this list, or blogs only? With blogs only, Zach's list is empty while 4 answers wait on him.

n-producer.text:
PRODUCER SCREEN
Sidebar goes from 16 places to 9: Home, Your week, Moments, Library, Insights, More (Ads, Bernard), Settings, My profile. Gone from the sidebar: Overview, SEO, Stories, Book, Pre-Visit, Usage, Knowledge synthesis.

Home is today's producer queue, unchanged, with one fix. Aj also does interviews. Today his own 3 blog drafts and 1 word sign-off show as "waiting on your clinicians, not on your queue", a dead end when the clinician is you. They become one row he can act on.

Rule: a producer or owner who has their own interviews sees their own approvals as theirs.
Applied: Aj gets the row (4 items). Alli has no interviews, so no row.

The checkpoint ledger, Bernard's note and What's new continue below, unchanged.

n-owner.text:
OWNER SCREEN
Sidebar: unchanged, all 16 places.
Home: unchanged. Your queue as the producer, then your practice as a clinician.

One addition: "See Bernard as", so you can open the Producer or Team member screen and see exactly what staff see. It only changes what is drawn. Your permissions stay the owner's.

Open question: is today's two-part home what you mean by full control, or do you want a different owner home?
